instagram.caption:
The first Pong machine broke down in a bar because it was too full of coins.

Atari put the prototype in a California tavern in 1972. A few days later the owner called to say it had stopped working.

The engineer who built it opened the coin box and quarters poured out. Atari knew right then that video games could make money.
